caption: On a glossy black surface lit by a soft bright gradient from the left, several gold Krugerrand-style coins with reeded rims tumble and settle, their springbok reverses and Paul Kruger busts catching the light. Three coins already in motion rotate and tilt as they come to rest in a loose row, the leftmost flattening out while the others settle to show the springbok face. A continuous stream of additional coins drops from above, each spinning edge-on before landing and stacking onto a growing cluster at the right-center, occluding one another in overlapping layers. Among them a large coin bearing the Kruger portrait and 'SUID-AFRIKA / SOUTH AFRICA' legend comes to rest tilted atop the heap. The leftmost coin stays isolated throughout, while dark oval mirror reflections remain fixed beneath the pile.
